strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hmm... It's not at full strength yet.
The Earth Sphere's turmoil won't last long... I can't take my time.
Mm... They've sniffed us out already...
As things stand in the Federation, the group I must be most wary of
is Londo Bell, it seems.
This robot... is it a mobile suit!?
At last, an enemy we can actually identify.
But this is no time to celebrate.
This mobile suit... it can't be Zeon's. Whose army is this?
And there's some huge mech out there too! Is that a battleship?
Looks kinda... like a flower.
Wow, how romantic... Or not, really.
Is it a mobile armor? But that size...
Ruri, try accessing the database.
Searching Omoikane's database... No match.
A flower of evil blooming out of nowhere, huh?
I, Gai Daigoji, will scatter its petals to the wind!
It does look like a flower... but a flower of evil should be prettier.
Yeah, yeah, like some gorgeous female executive...
Ooh, why not? "Female executive" has a nice ring to it.
A female executive, hm? I wouldn't get my hopes up.
Agreed. They're usually total monsters.
No data on it, but that thing's plainly nothing of the sort.
Mobile suits and a mobile armor...
That means they're not Jovian Lizards or aliens out to invade...
They're human, aren't they...?
Yeah... but they don't look like they'll let us off, either.
We'll have to fight... Let's go, Tenkawa, Hikaru, Izumi, Yamada!
These guys don't look like the kind you can take on lightly.
...Still, to develop something on that scale in secret...
They must be quite an organization.
Why are you griping just 'cause it's a little big?
If they're enemies, let's smash 'em all together!
Even so...
Quit sweating the small stuff, you're a guy, aren't you!? C'mon, let's sortie.
Sorry about that, Lieutenant Uraki. Pai's just more manly than most.
Is that supposed to be helping?
Captain Bright, shouldn't we sortie...?
Seems this is no time to fuss over size. Captain, we're heading out.
This army is probably... Right, we'll sortie and see what they do!
If they attack, engage and intercept! All units, launch!
We're launching too!
Come on, come at me from wherever you like...!
Hey, Shinobu! We were told not to make the first move!
I think it'll end up the same either way, though.
No doubt. People skulking around in an abandoned colony like this
can hardly be from a legitimate organization.
Captain, have you figured out who they are?
Oh? They mean to attack. Fully prepared... it would seem.
But... is this army really...?
What's wrong, Captain Bright?
Didn't you say earlier you'd figured out who this enemy was?
Or were you just pretending to know?
Well, Captain?
...I don't know. It's only a possibility. Hm...!?
I'd heard they had no real strength... but they seem quite well-equipped.
Even super robots from the last war... The odds are against me.
Retreating!? ...Well, at least that way we avoid needless fighting.
You lot, crush them.
My Rafflesia... I still have doubts about sending it into real combat.
The Black Vanguard will arrive shortly as well. You'll hold your own.
Roger. Commencing attack.
Whoa!? It shot off like a rocket!?
Something that big... How can it be so fast!?
It ran!? Tch, still, that's some incredible output.
To get that much speed out of something so huge...
No time to be impressed, Tetsuya! What about the rest of them!?
Commence attack!
They're attacking! Captain, we'll meet them head-on!
Damn it, this is no time for humans to fight each other...!
But we can't afford to fall here. Open fire!
This abandoned colony... Iron Mask, this is no time to draw attention,
and yet he does whatever he pleases...
Reinforcements?
Such efficiency... They must have planned on being discovered.
Huh!? Hey, Captain Quattro! What's that round thing?
A mobile armor from the old Zeon remnants...
What's the point of a project that's already been abandoned?
A Zaku head...!? Is that a mobile armor too!?
Hey, isn't it kinda cute?
I don't think that's the point...
If that's a new Zeon weapon... then is this army Zeon's?
Who knows?
Roux, didn't Judau stick a Zaku head on something once?
When the Zeta's head got wrecked.
He stuck on a stray Zaku head and hooked it right up to the monoeye.
Huh? The specs are totally different. Impressive he pulled that off.
First a giant flower, now a Zaku-headed turtle!
Is that a makeshift Zaku head too!?
Neither one really suits my taste.
A flower and a turtle... Maybe Spacenoids' yearning for nature
shows up in their weapon designs, too?
That's got nothing to do with it. Probably.
This is all pointless chatter. Bright, what do we do?
They're enemies... right?
None of this helps one bit. Captain, we're attacking!
Striking first is the way to win here.
Whether that thing's tied to Zeon or not, it's definitely an enemy.
Take them out one by one!
The Rafflesia is no less hideous, I suppose.
This battle doubles as a test of the mobile armor's performance.
Stay sharp!
Sir!
Heh... Not a style I dislike, though.
Really? I like 'em sleeker myself.
We're blasting it either way, though.
Heh! Like I'd lose to a botched rice cake! Let's do this!
This is the abandoned colony, right!?
Where's Lord Zabine? Wasn't he supposed to bring the new weapon?
...He went down to Earth on separate orders.
But there aren't many of them. We'll handle this ourselves!
Reinforcements? So efficient... They planned on being found.
Attacking already... Impatient bunch.
Pitch-black mobile suits? Hah, black is Mazinger's trademark.
You'd better have built 'em tough!
Koji, don't let your guard down!
Right, this is no time to flinch just because a few enemies showed up.
Let's go, Koji!
Black mobile suits...? Gutsy.
I'll teach them that black is Mazinger's trademark!
They look more fast than tough. Hope we don't struggle.
Right, this is no time to flinch just because a few enemies showed up.
Let's go, Tetsuya!
Careful, Tenkawa! Looks like enemy reinforcements!
Yeah, got it, Ryoko!
My, my, you two are perfectly in sync.
Hey! It's not like that!
Ryoko, please focus on the battle! You too, Akito!
Geez... why me too...? Anyway, these guys seem really experienced...
So this is what professional soldiers are like...
...A black mobile suit unit... This formation...
Bad news, isn't it? They look pretty skilled to me.
You see it too, Captain Misumaru?
Ruri!
They're not in the data, but the type matches. Probably... special forces.
Not only are they disciplined, they even have special-mission units
in their ranks.
...An organization this big... It's odd that there's no intel on it at all...
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Did we get them all? What were they doing in this area?
The mobile armor that ran off first... What was that?
Most likely an activation test of a new mobile armor.
Judging by the retreat and how fast the reinforcements came...
You mean they figured getting found was okay?
Exactly. With the Earth Sphere as it is... they'll make a move eventually.
Why do we gotta fight other humans when the Earth's in danger?
Yeah... We originally got together to help Mars, after all.
Never thought we'd get dragged into a war between humans too...
Yeah... It doesn't feel very good...
But we're under contract with Nergal...
Contract or not, the terms have kinda changed.
Humans or aliens, it doesn't matter,
I'll never forgive evil!
...But still, when so many forces are after the Earth,
for Earthlings to fight each other... It's sad...
It's our... home, after all.
(...My... home... Mars...)
Akito...
Home... huh.
Pai...?
Pai... Your memory... still hasn't come back?
Heh... Doesn't matter right now. It'll come back eventually. Besides...
Maybe some things are better left unremembered.
Pai!
Just kidding. Sorry, Lamba.
...There are also people for whom Earth isn't home.
You mean... the Spacenoids?
Yes. An overcrowded Earth... Hundreds of millions cast into space.
To people raised in artificial cradles,
can Earth truly be a beloved home...?
Hm...? Captain Quattro, what exactly are you trying to say?
Quattro... you're kinda scary.
...No... it's nothing. Captain, the enemy has pulled back. Returning.
...Very well. All units, return to ship.
(That army just now... what are they thinking?
What's their real aim in testing a mobile armor in a place like this...?)
